source_evidence: Some advisers only offer proprietary investment products. Cancellation may require the sale of some (or all) of the investments held in your account.
question: Misconception: If I cancel an advisory account, I can always transfer all my investments to another account without selling them.
answer: Not necessarily. Some advisers offer only proprietary investment products, and cancelling the advisory agreement may require selling some or all of the investments. Check whether the investments can be transferred to an account that is not managed by the adviser.
